The line starts near Huainan, Anhui Province, goes eastward past the vicinity of the Yangtze River, and leads to electricity consumption markets such as Jiangsu Province and Shanghai Municipality; the text in the figure also marks that the total length of the line is about 656 kilometers, and after completion it will transmit more than 50 billion kWh of electricity every year. Then reason: Huainan is an important coal producing area in Anhui, and both the project name and the materials indicate that what is sent eastward is electricity rather than directly transporting coal outward, indicating that coal is first converted into electric energy at or near the producing area and then transmitted to the eastern market. This can promote the combination of coal and electricity and the local conversion of coal, extend the coal industry chain, and increase added value, so it will raise the development level of the coal industry.
